scenes.name: inactive-window_coherence-light
scenes.probe: (() => { const box = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height]; }; const bar = document.querySelector('.part.titlebar'), center = document.querySelector('.command-center .action-item.command-center-center'); return { inactive: bar.classList.contains('inactive'), focused: document.hasFocus(), bar: getComputedStyle(bar).backgroundColor, center: center && { color: getComputedStyle(center).color, background: getComputedStyle(center).backgroundColor, box: box(center) } }; })()
